confidence_meaning: 1.0 reports the syntactic predicate; it is not a probability that a real bug exists
evidence: full source bytes SHA256, trusted rule/context and policy identities; raw evidence retained for freshness
guarantee: If assertions are enabled and tuple construction completes, the tuple truth check is true
identity: complete lexical symbol + full Assert AST structural hash + per-symbol/anchor occurrence
inventory_publication_guard: Compare the permitted inventory after final context revalidation and recheck access before publication; this is not an atomic filesystem or OS boundary.
predicate: Assert.test is nonempty Tuple and contains no Starred anywhere in the test subtree
scope: permitted .py and .pyi files parsed by the current Python AST; no target execution
starred_limitation: All Starred descendants are conservatively outside scope, even if other tuple elements would ensure nonemptiness
